# Generated by resources/tools/symbols/gen_layout_probe.py
add_executable(LayoutProbe probe_main.cpp probe_Core_0.cpp probe_Core_1.cpp probe_Core_2.cpp probe_Core_3.cpp probe_Engine_0.cpp probe_Engine_1.cpp probe_Engine_2.cpp probe_Engine_3.cpp probe_Engine_4.cpp probe_Engine_5.cpp probe_Engine_6.cpp probe_Engine_7.cpp probe_Engine_8.cpp probe_Engine_9.cpp probe_Engine_10.cpp probe_Engine_11.cpp probe_Engine_12.cpp probe_Engine_13.cpp probe_Engine_14.cpp probe_Engine_15.cpp)
# Take the modules' public include paths and defines without linking (or even building) their
# libraries: the probe only evaluates sizeof/offsetof and must stay buildable while a module's
# sources are red. ($<COMPILE_ONLY:Core> would still add Core as a build dependency.)
target_include_directories(LayoutProbe PRIVATE $<TARGET_PROPERTY:Core,INTERFACE_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES>)
target_compile_definitions(LayoutProbe PRIVATE $<TARGET_PROPERTY:Core,INTERFACE_COMPILE_DEFINITIONS>)
target_include_directories(LayoutProbe PRIVATE $<TARGET_PROPERTY:Engine,INTERFACE_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES>)
target_compile_definitions(LayoutProbe PRIVATE $<TARGET_PROPERTY:Engine,INTERFACE_COMPILE_DEFINITIONS>)
# Engine headers include png.h; pnglibconf.h is generated by the libpng build, so depend on the third-party targets (not on Core/Engine).
add_dependencies(LayoutProbe png_static zlibstatic)
dishonored_apply_defines(LayoutProbe)
target_compile_options(LayoutProbe PRIVATE ${DISHONORED_MSVC_WARNINGS} /wd4589 /bigobj)
set_target_properties(LayoutProbe PROPERTIES FOLDER "Tests")
add_custom_command(TARGET LayoutProbe POST_BUILD COMMAND $<TARGET_FILE:LayoutProbe> > "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/layout_probe.txt" COMMENT "layout probe -> layout_probe.txt")
